thread:
raj_customer: Hey, getting a bunch of 503s from the hosted /v1/generate endpoint in us-west1 since ~15:40 UTC. SDK v1.2.3. No rate-limit headers in responses, small payloads. Example curl attached below.

emma_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the request id(s) and exact timestamps? Also, do you do any token rotation on the client side?

raj_customer: req_id=abc123-def456, another req_id=abc123-def789. We rotate tokens every 10m by default. I disabled rotation for the test. P95 latency was creeping up to ~700ms before the 503s.

marta_oncall: Noted. @emma_support @sophia_sre I'm seeing matching ingress errors at that window — connection reset then upstream 503s. Edge dump: 
```
[2026-03-18T15:40:12Z] ingress: conn reset from 10.4.0.12 -> backend stream-transport: upstream 503
[2026-03-18T15:40:13Z] ingress: keepalive timeout hit, closing connection
```

liam_eng: Could be a transport stall during host churn. Which model + batch size? Any large KV cache misses?

raj_customer: model=redwood-3b-instruct, batch_size=1, prompt ~400 tokens. No large embedding calls in parallel.

sophia_sre: Checking infra — we saw an autoscaler pulse in us-west1 at 15:39 that cycled a small subset of hosts (scale-down then immediate up). Circuit-breaker metrics show a spike on a subset. Quick metrics snippet: 
```
ingress.503.count: +320 in 2m
edge.conn.reset: +150
backend.kvcache.miss_rate: 0.06
```

emma_support: Can you try a small repro for us? Two variants: with and without explicit Connection: keep-alive header. Paste results please.

raj_customer: Repro steps I used: 
1) spawn 50 concurrent curl requests looping for 60s against /v1/generate
2) disable client token rotation for the test
3) outcome: ~3-4% 503s appearing after ~30s into the run

liam_eng: Thanks. Hypothesis: a keepalive/half-close mismatch during host drain causes upstream to surface 503s. If the edge closes half-closed sockets while the runtime tries to reuse them, some requests race and hit 503. Can you try setting the SDK env override REDWOOD_KEEPALIVE_TIMEOUT=30s to align client keepalive? Also which SDK language?

raj_customer: Go SDK (v1.2.3). Will test with keepalive set.

marta_oncall: Immediate mitigation applied: increased edge keepalive to 45s and added a 5m hold for scale-down to avoid rapid host cycling. Also temporarily raised the customer's retry backoff recommended window to 10s (exp backoff).

deploy-bot: Deploy started: ingress/keepalive-adjustment v2 -> rolling to 3 nodes (eta ~4m)

sophia_sre: Collecting traces for the req_ids above and others in the window. @raj_customer we'll keep you posted; expected impact in ~10m. Confirming: billing unaffected by these retries.

raj_customer: Ran the adjusted test with the keepalive bump — errors dropped a lot: now ~0.5% 503s on the same loop. Looks much better.

liam_eng: Good. We'll schedule a runtime change to make connection draining more graceful during scale events (longer drain + retry-safe handoff). Also adding a guard to avoid closing connections in-flight when kvcache lookups are pending.

emma_support: Follow-up — can you run this quick script if you see more errors and paste the output?
```
TOKEN=<your_token>
ENDPOINT=https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
for i in {1..100}; do 
  curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Connection: keep-alive" "$ENDPOINT" &
done; wait
```

raj_customer: Ran it after the deploy — 0 failures in 2 runs. Thanks. We'll keep an eye on this during peak traffic tomorrow.

marta_oncall: We'll keep monitoring the us-west1 ingress metrics for the next 24h. Filed follow-up ticket RED-7891 for the runtime change.

emma_support: Closing the immediate escalation for now. If anyone sees reappearance, ping this thread or escalate to on-call. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
